performance.selection_policy: Latest archived forecast per race/model, captured at least five minutes before scheduled start.

CONTEXT_FORM_RESEARCH_V1.calibration_note: Runner observations within a race are dependent. Calibration bins are descriptive; uncertainty resamples whole races.

evaluation.threshold_note: 30 and 100 are research review milestones, not validation or profitability guarantees.
evaluation.comparison: Paired form-model minus equal-chance score on the same frozen field; negative values favour the form model.

limitations: Untrained context-weighted form research, not calibrated win probabilities. Distance, broad going, class similarity and course history reweight dated same-discipline outcomes using declared exploratory choices. No learned draw/pace bias, weight or official-rating effect, trainer/jockey statistics, fitness, market odds or verified EV. Inferred race discipline and sparse contextual evidence remain uncertain.
Every active runner requires three dated same-discipline resolved outcomes. Known non-finishes receive zero finish percentile; unresolved outcomes block forecasts.
Discipline provenance is retained; historical outcomes never include capture/race day. No prospective improvement is established before forward scoring.
This lane is separate from the existing all-weather baseline and failed held-out AW challenger.
